gated: manual (accept the Gemma terms on the Hub; huggingface_hub reads the user's token)
comment: Google DeepMind's EmbeddingGemma 300M checkpoint as a sentence-transformers model (Transformer -> mean Pooling -> Dense 768x3072 -> Dense 3072x768 -> Normalize). SHA-256 of every snapshot file the harness reads (model.safetensors, the Dense weights and tokenizer.json equal the Hub's LFS hashes at this revision), pinned 2026-11-06. The model card's front matter gives `license: gemma` and links the Gemma Terms of Use, whose Appendix lists EmbeddingGemma. The network code is transformers' Gemma3TextModel at the version Forge/uv.lock pins; the sentence-transformers modules (pooling, dense, normalize) are re-expressed from these configs in embeddinggemma_graphs.py.

terms.comment: The Gemma Terms of Use and the Gemma Prohibited Use Policy it incorporates (Section 3.2), as plain text extracted from the pages on 2026-11-06 and checked in beside this file (Forge/embeddinggemma/terms/). Section 3.1 requires a copy of the Agreement, the use restrictions, a modification notice and a NOTICE file with Google's notice line in every Distribution; the exporter bundles all of them. The pages' HTML hashes at retrieval are recorded for provenance only (the pages change with site chrome).
